settlement_source: League governing the game (NFL, nfl.com), 'the Governing League'
settlement_variable: Point differential (team score minus opponent score) over entire game incl. overtime unless otherwise specified; threshold e.g. wins by over 10.5
timezone: ET (all time periods ET; Expiration time 10:00 AM ET)
tie_handling: Tied: differential 0; 'wins by' any positive margin resolves No; 'exactly 0' resolves Yes.
rounding: Half-point strikes (x.5) so no push; no rounding
trading_close_vs_settlement: Listed close_time is placeholder ~2-3 days after game (game Nov 1, close Nov 3); can_close_early=1, settlement_timer 60s; expiration 10:00 AM ET, latest 15th day after game.
early_close_or_void_clauses: Suspended/abandoned after kickoff and not resuming within 48h: before 55 min of play -> last fair price (Exchange sole discretion) except already-decided markets; after 55 min or league declares final -> settle on state at that point. Postponed but starts within 48h -> stays open. Venue change: same home/away within 48h OK; reversal or >48h -> last fair price. Forfeit before kickoff -> last fair price. Stat corrections after expiration ignored. Market Outcome Review at discretion (Rule 6.3(d)).
title_vs_rules_divergences: Title 'wins by over X points?' vs rules: overtime points count; tie yields No.
Terms Source Agency is generic 'league governing <game>'; title says 'Pro Football' without naming NFL.
Title omits 55-minute suspension rule and last-fair-price outcomes.
toxicity_flags: In-game live score public with low latency; in-play quotes exposed to faster data than TV
Close time placeholder; halts at game end/early close
Discretionary last-fair-price on suspension before 55 minutes
Half-point strikes near margin boundaries amplify late-game jumps
